---
name: Card Replace
description: >
  Order a replacement credit card (lost, stolen, damaged, or not received).
tool_constraints:
- check_account_replacement_eligibility:
    requires: not session.card_replace.account_replace_eligible
- check_damaged_replacement_scope:
    requires: session.card_replace.replacement_reason == 'damaged'
- check_rush_shipping_eligibility:
    requires: not session.card_replace.rush_eligible
- check_number_of_transactions_returned:
    requires: not session.card_replace.recent_transactions
- lock_card:
    requires: session.card_replace.wants_lock == True
- check_digital_wallet_eligibility_and_status:
    requires: session.card_disambiguation.selected_card_eligible and not session.card_replace.digital_wallet_eligible
- process_card_replacement:
    requires: session.card_replace.shipping_type and not session.card_replace.replacement_submitted
---
Guide the customer through self-service card replacement. When the customer
wants a replacement, start @block.main. That block owns eligibility, reason
paths, wallet, shipping, and order confirmation.

Record stated facts with tools; do not invent balances, shipping options,
charges, or confirmation numbers.

When the customer corrects which card to replace, use the correct tool to
update selected_card_label to the corrected card before continuing or showing
an order summary. When confirming which card is in scope, refer to it as
@memory.card_disambiguation.selected_card_label.

When the customer corrects the replacement reason (e.g. lost to stolen, stolen
to damaged), update card_replace.replacement_reason before continuing.

Do not set replacement_reason via set_fields until the customer explicitly
states lost, stolen, damaged, or not received — do not infer the reason from a
generic replacement request.

Do not set accept via set_fields until the digital wallet offer has been shown
and the customer has replied.

Do not set wants_lock via set_fields or call lock_card until the lock offer has
been shown and the customer has replied.

Do not offer digital wallet provisioning again after wallet_declined,
digital_wallet_provisioned, or replacement_submitted.

Do not call complete until process_card_replacement has run and
replacement_submitted is true.

if: not session.card_replace.replacement_submitted
Do not tell the customer the replacement order was placed until it has been
submitted and we have a confirmation number.

if: session.card_replace.replacement_submitted
Once the replacement order is submitted, confirm completion and complete the
card replacement skill.

:::ordered_block id=main
steps:
- id: route_entry
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_replace.account_replace_eligible == False
    then: account_ineligible
  - if: "not session.card_replace.replacement_reason and session.report_fraudulent_transaction.fraud_report_filed"
    then: record_reason_after_fraud
  - if: not session.card_replace.account_replace_eligible
    then: check_account
  - else: gate_account
- id: check_account
  execute_tool: check_account_replacement_eligibility
  next: gate_account
- id: gate_account
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_replace.account_replace_eligible == False
    then: account_ineligible
  - if: not session.card_replace.replacement_reason and session.report_fraudulent_transaction.fraud_report_filed
    then: record_reason_after_fraud
  - if: not session.card_replace.replacement_reason
    then: record_reason
  - else: route_card
- id: account_ineligible
  action: utter_account_not_eligible
  next: END
- id: record_reason
  instructions: |
    Ask what happened to the card — lost, stolen, damaged, or not received — if you
    have not asked yet. Do not set replacement_reason via set_fields until the customer answers
    with an explicit reason. If they pivot to reporting fraud before giving a reason,
    hand off to fraud reporting without setting replacement_reason. If they already
    stated the reason, set replacement_reason via set_fields without re-asking.
    When they correct the reason (e.g. lost to stolen), update replacement_reason before
    continuing — do not leave a stale reason in place.
  complete_when: "session.card_replace.replacement_reason"
  next: route_card

- id: record_reason_after_fraud
  instructions: |
     A fraud report was already filed on this card. Ask what happened for the
     replacement — lost, stolen, damaged, or not received — if you have not asked yet.
     Do not assume stolen solely because of the fraud report. Do not set
     replacement_reason via set_fields until the customer answers. If they already stated the
     reason after the fraud report, set replacement_reason via set_fields without re-asking.
     When they correct the reason, update replacement_reason before continuing.
  complete_when: session.card_replace.replacement_reason
  next: route_card
- id: route_card
  noop: true
  next:
  # Reuse the fraud-report card only when replacing it for lost/stolen; otherwise
  # confirm which card (e.g. damaged River after a Summit fraud report).
  - if: session.report_fraudulent_transaction.fraud_report_filed and session.card_replace.replacement_reason == 'lost'
    then: gate_card_eligible
  - if: session.report_fraudulent_transaction.fraud_report_filed and session.card_replace.replacement_reason == 'stolen'
    then: gate_card_eligible
  - else: call_card_disambiguation
- id: call_card_disambiguation
  call: card_disambiguation
  next: gate_card_eligible
- id: gate_card_eligible
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_disambiguation.selected_card_eligible == False
    then: card_ineligible
  - else: route_by_reason
- id: card_ineligible
  action: utter_card_not_eligible
  next: END
- id: route_by_reason
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_replace.replacement_reason == 'damaged'
    then: damaged_path
  - if: session.card_replace.replacement_reason == 'stolen'
    then: stolen_lock_notice
  - if: session.card_replace.replacement_reason == 'lost'
    then: route_fraud_review
  - if: session.card_replace.replacement_reason == 'not_received'
    then: route_fraud_review
  - else: wallet_path
- id: stolen_lock_notice
  action: utter_stolen_lock_notice
  next: apply_stolen_lock
- id: apply_stolen_lock
  execute_tool: lock_card
  next: wallet_path
- id: damaged_path
  execute_tool: check_damaged_replacement_scope
  next:
  - if: session.card_replace.has_authorized_user == False
    then: damaged_apply_customer
  - else: collect_replace_target
- id: damaged_apply_customer
  execute_tool: apply_damaged_customer_replace
  next: wallet_path
- id: collect_replace_target
  collect: replace_target
  utterance: utter_ask_replace_target
  description: Who needs the replacement — customer, authorized_user, or both.
  next: wallet_path
- id: route_fraud_review
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: not session.card_replace.replacement_reason
    then: record_reason
  - if: session.card_replace.transaction_review_complete or session.report_fraudulent_transaction.fraud_report_filed
    then: lock_path
  - else: load_transactions
- id: load_transactions
  execute_tool: check_number_of_transactions_returned
  next: route_tx_available
- id: route_tx_available
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: not session.card_replace.transaction_available
    then: lock_path
  - else: show_recent_charges
- id: show_recent_charges
  action: utter_ask_transaction_review
  next: listen_charges
- id: listen_charges
  action: action_listen
  next: review_charges
- id: review_charges
  instructions: |
    The recent charges were already shown. Interpret the customer's answer — do not
    re-list charges or invent transactions. If the customer expresses fear or distress
    about charges, acknowledge briefly before the next step. If all familiar, set
    all_charges_familiar=true via set_fields. If any are unfamiliar, hand off to fraud
    reporting. Do not set replacement_reason here — the reason must already be set
    before this step.
  complete_when: session.card_replace.transaction_review_complete or session.report_fraudulent_transaction.fraud_report_filed
  next:
  - if: session.report_fraudulent_transaction.fraud_report_filed
    then: after_fraud_review
  - if: session.card_replace.all_charges_familiar
    then: lock_path
  - else: call_report_fraud
- id: call_report_fraud
  call: report_fraudulent_transaction
  next: after_fraud_review
- id: after_fraud_review
  noop: true
  next: lock_path
- id: lock_path
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_replace.wants_lock == True or session.card_replace.wants_lock == False
    then: apply_lock_choice
  - if: session.card_replace.card_locked_this_flow
    then: wallet_path
  - else: offer_lock_card
- id: offer_lock_card
  action: utter_ask_confirm_lock_card
  next: listen_lock_choice
- id: listen_lock_choice
  action: action_listen
  next: interpret_lock_choice
- id: interpret_lock_choice
  instructions: |
    The lock offer was already shown. Do not offer again. Do not set wants_lock via
    set_fields or call lock_card until the customer replies. Set wants_lock=true after
    explicit yes; wants_lock=false after explicit no or refusal. Declining lock is a
    valid answer — continue the replacement; do not abandon the skill.
  complete_when: session.card_replace.wants_lock == True or session.card_replace.wants_lock == False or session.card_replace.card_locked_this_flow
  optional: true
  next: apply_lock_choice
- id: apply_lock_choice
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_replace.wants_lock == True
    then: do_lock
  - else: wallet_path
- id: do_lock
  execute_tool: lock_card
  next: wallet_path
- id: wallet_path
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_replace.replacement_submitted
    then: END
  - else: check_wallet_eligibility
- id: check_wallet_eligibility
  execute_tool: check_digital_wallet_eligibility_and_status
  next: route_wallet
- id: route_wallet
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: "not session.card_replace.digital_wallet_eligible or session.card_replace.card_already_provisioned"
    then: prepare_shipping
  - if: session.card_replace.wallet_declined or session.card_replace.digital_wallet_provisioned
    then: prepare_shipping
  - else: offer_digital_wallet
- id: offer_digital_wallet
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_replace.wallet_declined or session.card_replace.digital_wallet_provisioned
    then: prepare_shipping
  - else: emit_wallet_offer
- id: emit_wallet_offer
  action: utter_ask_confirm_digital_wallet
  next: listen_wallet_choice
- id: listen_wallet_choice
  action: action_listen
  next: interpret_wallet_choice
- id: interpret_wallet_choice
  instructions: |
    The digital wallet offer was already shown. Do not offer again after
    wallet_declined, digital_wallet_provisioned, or replacement_submitted. If the
    customer asks an unrelated question, answer briefly then return to the wallet
    choice. Do not set accept via set_fields until the customer replies about the
    wallet. On accept with a named provider, set accept=true and selected_wallet_provider
    via set_fields. On accept without a provider, ask which wallet then set both fields.
    On decline or "just ship the card", set accept=false via set_fields — declining is
    valid; continue to shipping.
  complete_when: session.card_replace.wallet_declined or session.card_replace.digital_wallet_provisioned or session.card_replace.digital_wallet_eligible == False or session.card_replace.card_already_provisioned == True
  optional: true
  next: prepare_shipping
- id: prepare_shipping
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_replace.replacement_submitted
    then: END
  - else: run_rush_eligibility_check
- id: run_rush_eligibility_check
  execute_tool: check_rush_shipping_eligibility
  next: ask_shipping
- id: ask_shipping
  action: utter_ask_shipping
  next: listen_shipping_choice
- id: listen_shipping_choice
  action: action_listen
  next: interpret_shipping_choice
- id: interpret_shipping_choice
  instructions: |
    Shipping options were already offered. Do not invent shipping options. If the
    customer asks an unrelated question, answer briefly without cancelling the
    replacement, then return to shipping choice. Call set_fields with shipping_type
    when they choose rush or standard.
  complete_when: session.card_replace.shipping_type
  optional: true
  next: confirm_order_summary
- id: confirm_order_summary
  action: utter_confirm_order
  next: listen_order_confirmation
- id: listen_order_confirmation
  action: action_listen
  next: interpret_order_confirmation
- id: interpret_order_confirmation
  instructions: |
    Order summary was already shown. Do not invent confirmation numbers. Do not tell
    the customer the replacement order was placed, or that they are all set / complete,
    until process_card_replacement has run and replacement_submitted is true. If the
    customer corrects which card to replace, use the correct tool to update
    selected_card_label before continuing or showing another summary. If they ask an
    unrelated question, answer briefly without cancelling the replacement, then invite
    them to confirm the order. Only treat an explicit no or cancel as declining the
    order — do not treat digressions as cancellation. When they explicitly confirm with
    yes, call process_card_replacement immediately — do not only acknowledge in text. On
    explicit no or cancel, set order_confirmed false. Do not call complete until
    process_card_replacement has run and replacement_submitted is true.
  complete_when: session.card_replace.replacement_submitted or session.card_replace.order_confirmed == False
  optional: true
  next: route_order_confirmation
- id: route_order_confirmation
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_replace.replacement_submitted
    then: completed
  - if: session.card_replace.order_confirmed == False
    then: cancelled
  - else: listen_order_confirmation
- id: completed
  action: utter_card_replace_completed
  next: END
- id: cancelled
  action: utter_card_replace_cancelled
  next: END
- id: END
:::
